name: 2 kopeyki ili "Zolotoy" klyuchik (4-ye zhelaniye)
source:
And once again, a frosty winter evening... A strange bus... And once again, summer and the pioneer camp. And again, Semyon asks himself the same questions, trying to make sense of the twists of fate. And once more the difficulties of choice, adventures... But this time, a glitch has occurred in the series of endless cycles. Unnoticeable at first, it inexorably leads the hero to an unexpected resolution. What has fate prepared for Semyon? Will he get answers to all his questions? We will see...

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2897367960]Steam[/url]]
